phd.name: Xiuer Luo （2022.09—now）
phd.bio: I am a PhD student in the Department of Life Sciences at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.  I obtained my Bachelor's  degree in Food Quality and Safety from Nanchang University.  And I obtained my Master's degree in Food Science and Engineering from South China University of Tchnology. My PhD research focuses on nanopore protein sequencing and nanopore proteomics. Outside of research, I enjoy staying active through badminton, climbing, and hiking, while also relaxing with movies and spending time with animals.

phd.name: Jessie Wing Yin Wu （2022.09—now）
phd.bio: I graduated with a degree in Applied Biology and Biotechnology from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. My research interests lie in the macrophage biology and innate immunity, particularly how macrophage-intrinsic proteins regulate receptors-mediated recognition and phagocytosis of different targets, from bacterial pathogens to cancer cells. Outside the lab, I enjoy relaxing at home and taking things slow.

phd.name: Jiayu Lin (2024.01—now)
phd.bio:
My research focused on chemical biology and chemoproteomics, particularly the development of NAD-based photoaffinity and fluorescent probes to study NAD-associated proteins and pathways. I use mass spectrometry for molecular characterization, quantitative proteomics, and protein modification analysis. 
B. Sc. in Guang Dong University of Technology; M. Sc. in Jinan University

phd.name: Feifan Shi (2024.05—now)
phd.bio: Feifan Shi is currently a PhD student in the Department of Life Sciences within the School of Science at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. She obtained her bachelor's degree from Shenyang Pharmaceutical University in 2021 and then earned her master's degree from The University of Manchester, where she majored in clinical biochemistry. Her research interests focus on peptide drug discovery.
